**1 — Scene:** A breakfast plate with scrambled eggs, browned shredded potatoes, and a bagel half spread with cream cheese. Red sauce appears to be hot sauce.

**2 — Vessel:** A rounded-square plate, approximately 24 cm across. Using a 24 cm circular equivalent gives an estimated area of **452 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Bagel half, cream cheese, scrambled eggs, hash browns, and hot sauce. Cooking fat is included in the cooked-food energy estimates rather than added separately.

**4 — Area:** Bagel occupies approximately 23%, eggs 20%, and potatoes 18%: **61% total coverage**. Cream cheese covers about 18% of the plate within the bagel footprint; hot sauce covers about 1% within the eggs. These overlapping toppings add no additional plate coverage.
